meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 Linear 工单评论转为聊天会话
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队用 Linear 管理任务并希望直接在聊天中跟进评论。
copy.tagline_en: Turn Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team uses Linear for task management and wants to follow up comments in chat.

howto.what: 安装此技能后，Claude 会接入 Linear 频道。它参与 issue 的评论线程，每当有新的评论就自动加入回复，无需 @ 提及；每个 issue 线程独立为一个会话。
howto.when: 当所监控团队的 Linear issue 收到新评论时（经 webhook 接收），自动触发，在对应线程中回复。

say.text: 请查看这个 Linear issue 的最新讨论。
say.note: 在评论区发布后会自动触发 agent。

say.text: 这个方案有什么潜在问题？
say.note: 直接评论即可，agent 会回复。

say.text: 我来更新一下任务状态：已修复。
say.note: 评论本身就会让 agent 参与进来。

howto.what_en: This skill connects Claude to Linear as a channel. Claude joins issue comment threads and automatically replies to every new comment, with no @-mention required; each issue thread becomes its own conversation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a new comment is posted on an issue in the monitored team (received via webhook), auto-replying in that thread.

say_en.text: Please check the latest discussion on this Linear issue.
say_en.note: Posting it in a comment triggers the agent automatically.

say_en.text: What are the potential problems with this plan?
say_en.note: Just comment; the agent will reply.

say_en.text: Let me update the task status: fixed.
say_en.note: Any comment lets the agent join in.
